hero.announcement: Business buyer? Apply once to unlock wholesale account pricing.
hero.body: {{storeName}} is a factory-direct supplier moving quality goods across Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Tanzania and the wider region. Wholesale pricing for buyers, retail for everyone — quoted in your local currency.
hero.paths_title: Built for every size of order.
hero.retail_body: Buy what you need at public prices, quoted in your local currency.
hero.wholesale_body: Apply for an approved account to access volume pricing and business payment options.

showcase.title: Ready to ship
showcase.empty: Catalogue is being stocked. Check back shortly.

how.title: Built for the way Africa actually trades.
how.step1_body: Prices show in NGN, KES, XOF, GHS or USD based on your region. No guesswork at checkout.
how.step2_body: Paystack, OPay and Interswitch — cards, transfers and mobile money. Bank transfer and COD for wholesale.
how.step3_body: Every order carries a live status — dispatched, in transit, out for delivery, delivered.

product.bulk_hint: Wholesale price applies automatically at {min}+ units — no account needed.
product.related_subtitle: You might also want to check out these products.
product.ship_fast_body: Your package will arrive in 3-5 business days at your pick up location or in the comfort of your home.
product.ship_exchange_body: Is the fit not quite right? No worries - we'll exchange your product for a new one.
product.ship_returns_body: Just return your product and we'll refund your money. No questions asked – we'll do our best to make sure your return is hassle-free.
